name: navidrome-stat
description: Self-hosted listening statistics for Navidrome. Explore playback history, artist and album rankings, listening charts, and monthly and yearly reviews across clients and servers. Uses a local SQLite database. Set a dashboard administrator token, then add your Navidrome servers in Settings > Connections after signing in. Recording depends on playback reported to Navidrome; installation does not recover a complete past history.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Dedicated local directory for SQLite, the credential key, and artwork cache. Must be writable by UID/GID 1000:1000; see the ReadMe before installing.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Dashboard port. Change the host port if it is already in use; keep container port 39421.

variables.name: Administrator token
variables.description: Required: enter a long, random token for dashboard login. Keep it private. Add Navidrome connections in the dashboard after signing in.

variables.name: Database path
variables.description: SQLite file inside the persistent appdata mount. Keep this path unchanged for normal installations.

variables.name: Viewer token
variables.description: Optional read-only dashboard token. Must differ from the administrator and ListenBrainz tokens. Leave empty to disable viewer access.

variables.name: Secure session cookie
variables.description: Set true when accessing the dashboard through HTTPS. Leave false for direct HTTP access.

variables.name: Protect metrics
variables.description: Require administrator authentication for the metrics endpoint.
